description: Three-tier evidence gradient and quality gate protocol for low-energy nuclear structure

observables: Coulomb excitation particle-gamma coincidence yields with CHICO2+GRETINA

quantities: Intrinsic Q3 = 1742 e fm^3 (rotor model conversion)
tier2_derived_strength.quality_gate: Requires explicit Weisskopf unit convention (1.2 A^(1/3) fm) and spin degeneracy factor (7x).

models: Gogny D1S SCCM wave function projection
tier3_model_interpretation.mechanism: Large-amplitude soft octupole vibration in shallow well; high delta_E(I) platform (>300 keV) excludes rigid static pear shape.
tier3_model_interpretation.boundary: Large direct E3 does NOT prove static deformation without stable double-well minimum.

benchmarks.phenomenon: Octupole collectivity with E1 dipole cancellation

tier2_derived_strength.quality_gate: E1 is extracted from lifetimes/branching; data is insensitive to relative sign of E1 and E3.

models: Gogny D1S SCCM particle-number and parity projection
tier3_model_interpretation.mechanism: Neutron single-particle occupancy of nu(1h9/2, 2f7/2, 1i13/2) creates a negative polarization dipole that cancels the proton pi(2d5/2-1h11/2) dipole.
tier3_model_interpretation.boundary: Cancellation point is sensitive to dD0/dv^2 ~ -0.77 e fm; 21x SCCM amplitude discrepancy is due to high-order zero-crossing gradient.

quantities: Mean tunneling splitting Delta E0 = 31.31 keV
tier2_derived_strength.quality_gate: Requires K=1/2 rotational Hamiltonian with signature decoupling term.

tier3_model_interpretation.mechanism: Intrinsic reflection asymmetry enforces opposite-sign decoupling parameters a+ ~ -a-, naturally reproducing alternating sign staggering.
tier3_model_interpretation.boundary: Apparent parity inversion at 3/2 and 7/2 is a Coriolis dynamic effect, not shape coexistence.

tier2_derived_strength.quality_gate: Ratio derived from branching; post-crossing rebound trajectory is a TAC prediction, not an experimental measurement.

tier3_model_interpretation.mechanism: 3qp pi(h11/2) x nu(h11/2)^-2 crosses at hbar*omega ~ 0.37 MeV to 5qp pi(h11/2)(g7/2)^2 x nu(h11/2)^-2, abruptly reopening the shears angle from 15 deg to 75 deg.
tier3_model_interpretation.boundary: Wobbling hypothesis excluded by M1 dominance and E_wob sign inversion; core quadrupole deformation beta2 ~ 0.14 provides persistent E2 pedestal.

observables: DSAM state lifetimes: tau(16+) = 0.36(3) ps to tau(24+) = 0.27(7) ps
tier1_direct_experiment.source: Roy et al. PLB 694, 322 (2011); NNDC ENSDF 110048001
tier1_direct_experiment.uncertainty_type: DSAM line-shape fitting with stopping power uncertainty (~20%)

quantities: Dynamic moment of inertia J^(2) = 15 - 35 hbar^2/MeV
Giant ratio J^(2)/B(E2) = 116 - 341 hbar^2 MeV^-1 (e^2 b^2)^-1
tier2_derived_strength.quality_gate: J^(2)/B(E2) carries physical units and depends on centering schemes; cannot be treated as a dimensionless hard gate.

models: Classical double-shears + semi-rigid core rotor model
tier3_model_interpretation.mechanism: Composite anti-unitary symmetry R_y(pi)*T cancels transverse magnetic dipoles (mu_perp = 0); B(E2) follows sin^4(theta) power law, while semi-rigid core rotation delays closing.
tier3_model_interpretation.boundary: Non-zero static longitudinal magnetic moment mu_z exists; 104Pd shows that high-frequency E2 drop can also be driven by deformation shrinkage.

quality_gate_rules: Rule 1: Never cite Tier 3 model outputs (e.g. Q3 rotor conversions, TAC closing angles) as Tier 1 experimental measurements.
Rule 2: Check multi-step conversion units explicitly: 1 W.u.(E3) ~ 1200-2900 e^2 fm^6; B(E3; 0->3) = 7 * B(E3; 3->0); 1 b = 100 fm^2.
Rule 3: Maintain competing interpretations: soft octupole vibration vs static reflection asymmetry; shears reopening vs wobbling softening; core coupling vs pure shears.
Rule 4: In unmeasured channels (e.g. E2 crossover in 135Pr at high spin, or missing lines in 110Cd), mark as model-predicted rather than experimentally observed.
